mechanism_narrative: A current federal funds rate below 0.25% predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as accommodative monetary policy reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and decreases in unemployment rate signal an overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts below 600,000 units predict reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, the signal of HOUST < 600.0 fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current monthly payroll increase above 150,000 jobs predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as strong labor conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals accelerating wage growth and inflation, prompting monetary tightening that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, industrial production below 95.0 (index) signals weakening manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery, the signal of INDPRO < 95.0 fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.
